text:
Plan these 26 modules: scheduler, media, ingest, catalog, profile, quota, auth, sync, reports, indexer, billing, shipping, audit, upload, search, inventory, tenant, gateway, pricing, archive, notify, session, metrics, cache.

Final values (supersede all drafts): catalog.ttl_s=390, session.ttl_s=330, gateway.ttl_s=180, auth.ttl_s=240, upload.batch_size=700, scheduler.batch_size=400, scheduler.max_workers=14, reports.batch_size=350, reports.max_workers=14, metrics.max_workers=32, metrics.timeout_s=55, notify.batch_size=750, ingest.max_workers=16, quota.max_workers=20, archive.queue_depth=450, search.batch_size=400.

Triggered limits: session.queue_depth≤20, quota.queue_depth≤30, notify.max_workers≥30, inventory.retry_limit≤3, media.timeout_s≥120, auth.batch_size≤100, tenant.retry_limit≥8, shipping.batch_size≥900.

Ownership: delta={search,sync,billing,reports,archive}; gamma={audit,quota,ingest}; alpha={shipping}; beta={inventory,gateway}. Metrics and session share a worker. Profile not on delta. Pricing not with shipping. Metrics not with quota. Files: stubs.py→audit, worker.py→quota, adapters.py→tenant, client.py→metrics, core.py and serial.py→profile, models.py→notify, jobs.py→inventory.

Declare: quota→archive, gateway→ingest, scheduler→inventory, archive→profile and scheduler, cache→search, tenant→session, catalog→audit.
Forbidden paths: archive→media, reports→scheduler, pricing→reports, gateway→indexer.
Order: inventory before reports; media before cache; shipping and session before indexer.

Everything else is your call.
